fields.why: Prevalence is estimated for 5 race groups, 3 age groups and 4 parental-education levels, each tested against a marked referent (Table note ††, ¶¶ t-tests).

Race (5 levels vs White), age (3 levels vs 12–17) and parental education (4 levels vs 4-yr college) are the SPDs with 3+ groups; insurance, home ownership and Hispanic origin have 2 levels; physical activity is not an SPD.
Methods: 'Differences in subgroups were tested against a reference group using a t-test'; no omnibus or trend test, so each SPD is per-group vs referent with resolves_to_finer true.
